# A token the collection cannot go on from is 403 with
# <D:error><D:valid-sync-token/></D:error>: the device syncs in full.
@collection calendar arbeit Arbeit
@seed calendar arbeit a.ics dentist.ics

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< save old sync-token

# The calendar is deleted and made again with the same name: a new epoch.
> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/
> Auth: alex
< status 204

> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/
> Auth: alex
< status 201

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

< status 403
< error d:valid-sync-token
